API docs by Redocly

Enterprise MAS API (0.1.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:Download

Tenant-facing HTTP v1 API for enterprise-mas. Every route answers the stable envelope ApiEnvelope { data | StableApiError, meta }; bearer JWT or API-key authentication on protected routes; SSE (text/event-stream) for /v1/stream; keyset pagination on list endpoints.

health

Liveness probe (root alias)

Convenience alias of GET /v1/health/live for probes that expect a root health path.
